name: Nikhil Raj
title: Full Stack Developer | Software Development Engineer (SDE)

projects.name: Coding Platform
highlights: Built a full-stack coding platform for practicing and solving DSA problems, with problem creation, submission, and automated evaluation.
Implemented secure user authentication and authorization for personalized, session-based access.
Designed problem-creation module supporting structured descriptions and constraints.
Developed automated code submission and test-case validation pipeline to evaluate user solutions in real time.
Added real-time problem-count tracking to improve user navigation and engagement.

projects.name: VizuCode - LeetCode Visualizer
highlights: Built an interactive visualizer for 300+ LeetCode questions across 16 categories, with step-by-step algorithm traces synced to C++/Java source code.
Designed 10 reusable visualization templates (binary search, arrays, trees/graphs, DP grids, heaps, linked lists) with transport controls and tag-synced code highlighting.
Developed a REST API with JWT authentication and per-user progress tracking; frontend falls back to local data if the API is unavailable.
Hardened the API with rate limiting, input validation, and security headers; added persisted light/dark theming.

projects.name: Threads Clone
projects.description: An online social media application where users can share photos, like different posts and repost them.
highlights: Built a Threads-style social media app where users share posts with photos, like posts and repost them.
Implemented sign-up and login with bcrypt password hashing and JWT authentication on an Express + MongoDB (Mongoose) backend.
Handled photo uploads with Cloudinary and modelled users, posts and comments with followers, likes, replies and reposts.
Built the React frontend with Redux Toolkit and Material UI: home feed, single-post view with comments, user search, and profile tabs for threads, replies and reposts.
